stem.text: A loudspeaker is playing music in a room. The door to the room is open and has a width of $0.80\,\text{m}$.
Sound waves of many different frequencies pass through the doorway and diffract. The speed of sound in air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
Which frequency of sound wave diffracts the most as it passes through the doorway?
